card.name: Just before a hyphen in compound names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a name or letter right before a hyphen that joins it to a second capitalized name or letter. Seen in hyphenated language families, paired surnames, bond pairs and party-state tags.

modes.label: Language and family names
modes.description: End of a name before a hyphen and another language or group name.
modes.example: belongs to the Siouan branch of the Hok<<an>>-Siouan linguistic stock

modes.label: Paired surnames and terms
modes.description: End of the first surname in a two-name compound.

modes.label: Single letters before a hyphen
modes.description: A letter or element symbol that is followed by a hyphen and another capital, as in bond tables or party codes.

card.writes: It promotes capitalized hyphen-joined continuations (-St, -Y, -Sh, -P) and suppresses lowercase ones, so a capitalized second part is expected after the hyphen.
card.plain: It notices a name that is about to be joined by a hyphen to a second capitalized name.
